keyFindings.description: stillLiveAhead compares the open value the unlocked listing read, but a document is live ahead only when the issue is open under the owner lock (:326, :363). A reopen landing between the listing and the lock caches the document with open=false; if the issue closes again before a settlement writes a version and nothing moves marked_at (a document with no asks), every later listing reads open=false, the cache matches, and the closed document is never indexed until a restart: round 9's symptom again. Fix: use the cache only while the listing sees the issue open (document.open in stillLiveAhead, or cache only when document.open).
